cubic_readout.paired_means: 1-(A+A^(-1))*z+z^2; product of two separately averaged probes
cubic_readout.source_domain: With physical t=q^(-1/2), X=q^u,Y=q^v, real u,v<1/7: z=q^(-s) is attainable only for Re(s)>15/14. This is the absolute period-box limit, not a global impossibility theorem.

cubic_spectrum.coverage: Every sorted nonzero triple with sum zero modulo 7 is one of the eight table entries; exact kernel-checked finite classification.
cubic_spectrum.interpretation: Classically these formal Gauss multisets have quadratic CM and degree-six CM natural fields before unitary normalization. The field/Galois and global Hecke identifications are not Lean theorems here.
cubic_spectrum.geometry: Every t/X/Y weight is retained; the six repeated-entry terms are not an unweighted field trace at arbitrary physical torus parameters.

jacobi_packets.probe: 1+((2*P0-S_mask)^3-P0^3)/m, m=3 or 6; all principal coordinates retained
jacobi_packets.reciprocity: At R=1, P(W^2*V,U)=W^6*P(U,V) for the homogeneous six-root packet; product of separately averaged probes.
jacobi_packets.abel_domain: At t^2*X0^7=t^2*Y0^7=1, radial X=r*X0,Y=r*Y0, 0<=r<1, satisfies both absolute HasSum bounds. Left-neighborhood filter at r=1 is explicitly nontrivial.
jacobi_packets.balanced_corner: For nonzero u: t=u^7,X0=Y0=u^(-2); all eight weights equal u^15. Dividing compensated mean-minus-one by u^15 yields the Abel limit -phase_i.
jacobi_packets.physical_cost: For u=q^(-1/14), normalization costs q^(15/14). Every individual scalar absolute period box is s>15/14; no QRH gain.
jacobi_packets.lifting: Conditional on -w_r=(-v_r)^n for every positive grade, extracted_i(w)=extracted_i(v)^n. Classical compatible finite-field lifting and torus scaling are separate inputs.

curve_readout.field_domain: Every finite field F with an actual MulChar F Complex of order seven and a primitive AddChar; rho nonzero with rho^2=card(F), and arbitrary nonzero boundary scale u.
curve_readout.curve: z^7=x(1-x); N_aff counts actual affine solutions
curve_readout.character_fibers: # {z:z^7=a}=1+sum_(r=1..6) chi^r(a), including a=0; proved without a counting hypothesis.
curve_readout.abel_trace: Sum of the six compensated normalized coherent roots tends nontrivially to (q-N_aff)/rho.
curve_readout.choice_dependence: The right-hand side contains neither additive character nor rho nor u.
curve_readout.classical_interpretation: The smooth projective completion is a genus-three cyclic Fermat quotient with one rational point at infinity; its local zeta numerator is the displayed Jacobi polynomial. Geometry and full lifting/zeta formalism are cited classical inputs, not Lean declarations here.
curve_readout.small_characteristics: The Kummer count theorem includes characteristic two whenever the order-seven character exists. The model Y^2=1-4X^7 is used only in odd characteristic. Characteristic seven is excluded by the source datum and cannot support an order-seven character on the finite-field unit group.
curve_readout.analytic_cost: Physical u=q^(-1/14),rho=sqrt(q): trace normalization costs q^(15/14), and the unnormalized Euler-polynomial variable rescales by q^(11/7). No uniform analytic estimate follows.
curve_readout.novelty: The curve, Jacobi sums and zeta formula are classical. Priority of their precise identification with this full compensated G2 source observation is not established.
